key_insight: Giving a language model read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raised quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% for standard passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of solar-cell measurements require structured experimental records, not text retrieval alone.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers from 45,441 measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers.
Evaluate structured SQL access using an open 14B model on a single 24 GB GPU.
evidence_signal: SQL-enabled accuracy reached 51.5% on historical literature and 50.8% on prospective literature, while zero-shot accuracy was 1.6–6.5%.
watch_item: Accuracy remains near 51%, and deployment depends on extracting and maintaining trustworthy structured device records.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
